description: AlphaFold PAE and pLDDT for LONRF1 domains, and burial of each RING E2-binding face in the full-length model
code:
import requests, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
pd.set_option("display.width",320)

AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
     'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
     'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse_pdb(t):
    at=[]
    for ln in t.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
        if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[16] in (" ","A"):
            at.append(dict(name=ln[12:16].strip(),resn=ln[17:20].strip(),resi=int(ln[22:26]),
                xyz=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])]),bfac=float(ln[60:66] or 0)))
    return at
ent=[e for e in requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q17RB8",timeout=90).json() if e["entryId"]=="AF-Q17RB8-F1"][0]
M=parse_pdb(requests.get(ent["pdbUrl"],timeout=200).text)
pae=np.array(requests.get(ent["paeDocUrl"],timeout=200).json()[0]["predicted_aligned_error"],dtype=float)
print("PAE matrix:",pae.shape)

R1=list(range(123,159)); R2=list(range(479,517))
TPR=list(range(40,90))+list(range(205,315)); LON=list(range(558,769))
def blockPAE(a,b): 
    ia=[i-1 for i in a]; ib=[j-1 for j in b]
    return float(np.mean(pae[np.ix_(ia,ib)]))
print("\nMean inter-domain PAE (A)   (low = confident relative placement)")
for n,a in [("RING1",R1),("RING2",R2)]:
    for m,b in [("TPRarray",TPR),("LonSBD",LON),("RING2",R2),("RING1",R1)]:
        if n==m: continue
        print(f"  {n:6s} vs {m:9s}: {blockPAE(a,b):5.1f}")

# burial of the E2-binding face in the full-length model
E2FACE={"RING1":[124,125,127,146,149,150,153,156,157,159],
        "RING2":[480,481,483,502,505,506,509,514,515,517]}
allat=np.array([a["xyz"] for a in M])
allres=np.array([a["resi"] for a in M])
rows=[]
for ring,face in E2FACE.items():
    dom=set(R1) if ring=="RING1" else set(R2)
    for r in face:
        sc=[a["xyz"] for a in M if a["resi"]==r and a["name"] not in ("N","C","O")]
        if not sc: continue
        sc=np.array(sc)
        ext_mask=~np.isin(allres, list(dom))
        d=np.linalg.norm(allat[ext_mask][:,None,:]-sc[None,:,:],axis=-1) if ext_mask.sum() else None
        n8=int((d<8).sum()) if d is not None else 0
        aa=[AA3[a["resn"]] for a in M if a["resi"]==r][0]
        rows.append(dict(ring=ring,res=f"{aa}{r}",
                         contacts_within_8A_from_rest_of_protein=n8))
bt=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\nBurial of the predicted E2-binding face by the rest of the full-length AlphaFold model")
print(bt.to_string(index=False))
print("\nMean neighbour count:"); print(bt.groupby("ring").contacts_within_8A_from_rest_of_protein.mean().round(1).to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
im=ax[0].imshow(pae,cmap="Greens_r",vmin=0,vmax=31)
for s,e,c,lab in [(123,159,"#c44e52","RING1"),(479,517,"#4c72b0","RING2"),(558,768,"#dd8452","Lon SBD")]:
    ax[0].add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s,s),e-s,e-s,fill=False,ec=c,lw=2))
    ax[0].text(e+8,(s+e)/2,lab,color=c,fontsize=9,va="center")
ax[0].set_xlabel("residue"); ax[0].set_ylabel("residue")
ax[0].set_title("AlphaFold predicted aligned error, human LONRF1 (Q17RB8)",fontsize=10)
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax[0],label="PAE (A)",fraction=0.046)

pl=np.array([(a["resi"],a["bfac"]) for a in M if a["name"]=="CA"])
ax[1].plot(pl[:,0],pl[:,1],lw=1,color="#555")
for s,e,c,lab in [(123,159,"#c44e52","RING1"),(479,517,"#4c72b0","RING2"),(558,768,"#dd8452","Lon SBD")]:
    ax[1].axvspan(s,e,color=c,alpha=.25)
    seg=pl[(pl[:,0]>=s)&(pl[:,0]<=e),1]
    ax[1].text((s+e)/2,103,f"{lab}\n{seg.mean():.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=8,color=c)
ax[1].axhline(70,ls="--",c="grey",lw=.8); ax[1].axhline(90,ls=":",c="grey",lw=.8)
ax[1].set_ylim(20,112); ax[1].set_xlabel("residue"); ax[1].set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax[1].set_title("Per-residue model confidence, human LONRF1",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
